definitions.explanation: The last day of the year.

examples.japanese: {大晦日|おおみそか}は{忙|いそが}しい。
{大晦日|おおみそか}は{紅白|こうはく}を{見|み}る。
examples.english: On New Year's Eve, we watch Kohaku.

examples.japanese: {大晦日|おおみそか}に{年越|としこ}しそばを{食|た}べる。
examples.english: To eat year-crossing soba on New Year's Eve.

examples.japanese: {大晦日|おおみそか}の{夜|よる}は{家族|かぞく}みんなで{過|す}ごす。
examples.english: We spend New Year's Eve night together as a family.

examples.japanese: {大晦日|おおみそか}の{夜|よる}には{除夜|じょや}の{鐘|かね}が{聞|き}こえてきて、{新|あたら}しい{年|とし}が{始|はじ}まるのを{感|かん}じる。
examples.english: On New Year's Eve, you can hear the temple bells ringing, and you feel the new year beginning.
examples.notes: Temple bells are rung 108 times at midnight

notes:
CULTURAL:
New Year's Eve customs include:
- {年越|としこ}しそば (toshikoshi soba): eating soba noodles for longevity
- {紅白歌合戦|こうはくうたがっせん} (Kohaku): NHK's annual music show
- {除夜|じょや}の{鐘|かね} (joya no kane): temple bells rung 108 times at midnight
- {大掃除|おおそうじ} (oosouji): year-end cleaning
